simple.meaning: שֶׁרֶץ (sherets) is a Hebrew word meaning “a swarm , i.e. active mass of minute animals.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: שֶׁרֶץ (H8318) appears 15 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Genesis 1:20, with occurrences in Genesis, Leviticus, Deuteronomy.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שֶׁרֶץ (H8318) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in שֶׁרֶץ (H8318) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: שֶׁרֶץ (sherets) / H8318 is traced through Genesis 1:20, Genesis 7:21, Leviticus 5:2, Leviticus 11:10 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

structuredEvidence.definition: a swarm , i.e. active mass of minute animals

firstOccurrence.englishText: God said, “Let the waters abound with living creatures, and let birds fly above the earth in the open expanse of the sky.”

majorEvents.label: Defilement
majorEvents.evidenceText: You shall not make yourselves abominable with any creeping thing that creeps. You shall not make yourselves unclean with them, that you should be defiled by them.

timeline.evidenceText: God said, “Let the waters abound with living creatures, and let birds fly above the earth in the open expanse of the sky.”
All flesh died that moved on the earth, including birds, livestock, animals, every creeping thing that creeps on the earth, and every man.

“ ‘Or if anyone touches any unclean thing, whether it is the carcass of an unclean animal, or the carcass of unclean livestock, or the carcass of unclean creeping things, and it is hidden from him, and he is unclean, then he shall be guilty.
All that don’t have fins and scales in the seas and rivers, all that move in the waters, and all the living creatures that are in the waters, they are an abomination to you,
“ ‘All flying insects that walk on all fours are an abomination to you.
Yet you may eat these: of all winged creeping things that go on all fours, which have long, jointed legs for hopping on the earth.
But all winged creeping things which have four feet are an abomination to you.
“ ‘These are they which are unclean to you among the creeping things that creep on the earth: the weasel, the rat, any kind of great lizard,
These are they which are unclean to you among all that creep. Whoever touches them when they are dead shall be unclean until the evening.
“ ‘Every creeping thing that creeps on the earth is an abomination. It shall not be eaten.
Whatever goes on its belly, and whatever goes on all fours, or whatever has many feet, even all creeping things that creep on the earth, them you shall not eat; for they are an abomination.
You shall not make yourselves abominable with any creeping thing that creeps. You shall not make yourselves unclean with them, that you should be defiled by them.
For I am Yahweh your God. Sanctify yourselves therefore, and be holy; for I am holy. You shall not defile yourselves with any kind of creeping thing that moves on the earth.
or whoever touches any creeping thing whereby he may be made unclean, or a man from whom he may become unclean, whatever uncleanness he has—
All winged creeping things are unclean to you. They shall not be eaten.

definitions.short: a swarm , i.e. active mass of minute animals
definitions.full: H8318. sherets שֶׁ֫רֶץ noun masculine Gen 7:21 collective swarmers, swarming things ; — ׳שׁ absolute Lev 11:29 +, שָׁ֑רֶץ 11:31 ; construct 11:20 +; — swarming things (H D and P), aquatic Gen 1:20 ; Lev 11:10 ; small reptiles and quadrupeds Gen 7:21 (+ חַיָּה בְּהֵמָה, עוֺף, ), Lev 5:2 (+ בְּהֵמָה חַיָּה, ), 11:29 (weasel, mouse, lizard), 11:31 ; 11:41 ; 11:42 ; 11:43 (with cognate שָׁרַץ ), 11:44 , compare 22:5 ; insects, ׳שׁ הָעוֺף Deut 14:19 , + עַלאַֿרְעַ הַהֹלֵךְ Lev 11:20-21 , compare 11:23 . compare 11:23 ,. compare Dr DB i. 519 .
